title: AI-led digital engineering deal: Persistent Systems to acquire Nagarro in EUR 81-per-share offer
key_facts: Persistent Systems said on Saturday (3 Oct 2026) it will take over German digital engineering firm Nagarro through a voluntary public takeover offer of EUR 81 per share in cash for all shares.
The offer is a premium of about 140 per cent to the 25 June 2026 closing price and about 94 per cent to the three-month volume-weighted average price.
Nagarro's management and supervisory boards support it and intend to recommend acceptance, subject to review of the offer document.
Lantano Beteiligungen, the vehicle of Nagarro's largest shareholder, agreed to sell its roughly 21 per cent stake at the offer price.
The companies say the combined group has a USD 2.9 billion revenue run-rate and more than 46,000 employees in over 40 countries.
Financing is committed from Barclays; Persistent intends to delist Nagarro from the Frankfurt regulated market when practicable; no timeline given.
Nagarro is Munich-based, about 18,500 employees, revenue EUR 1 billion in calendar 2025.
quote_evidence: Persistent Systems said on Saturday that it will takeover German digital engineering firm Nagarro.
Under that agreement, Lantano agreed to sell its entire stake to Galaxy Germany.
why_it_matters_hint: A large cross-border takeover bid joins two AI-focused engineering services firms.
notes: Text is largely company release wording; figures are company claims. Event before 4 Oct, so score lowered by 1.
